50352413.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to ERRgamma (unknown origin) at 20 degC by isothermal titration calorimetry

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods - 3.14. Isothermal: Isothermal titration calorimetry experiments were performed using a MicroCal ITC200 (GE Healthcare) at 20 °C. The protein eluted from gel filtration was concentrated by ultrafiltration (Millipore Amicon) and supplemented with dimethyl sulfoxide (DMSO) to a final concentration of 0.24%. Small molecules were diluted in the same buffer from 50 mM stock in DMSO. All solutions were degassed before titrations were performed. The sample cell was filled with 200 μL small molecule in 122 μM and the syringe was filled with 60 μL protein in 1.36 mM. The titration consisted of an initial injection of 0.5 μL followed by 19 injections of 2 μL. To determine the baseline, the protein was titrated into the same cell without the small molecules under the same conditions. Data was analyzed with the software Origin 7.0 (OriginLab) using the one set of sites model.
original_paragraph.Figure 4 caption: Figure 4. Isothermal calorimetric analysis of the binding interaction between ERRγ-LBD and compound 2e.
original_paragraph.Figure 4 inset data: Data: pl0138_NDH Model: OneSites Chisq/DoF = 2521 N = 1.73 ± 0.0560 Sites K = 2.18E4 ± 2.38E3 M⁻¹ ΔH = -2769 ± 48.37 cal/mol ΔS = -70.4 cal/mol/deg
